title: Layered soil profile and effective vertical stress
description: Reusable SVG soil-profile component with three configurable layers, water-table location, and total/pore/effective vertical stress at a query depth.
learningObjectives: Integrate vertical overburden stress through layered soils using stated natural and saturated unit weights.
Apply Terzaghi effective stress σ′v = σv − u below a hydrostatic water table.

verification.notes: Rebuilt as a real Three.js cutaway soil block with water-table and stress markers; independent rendered comparison pending.
